  [0m[38;2;177;185;249m/srv/archive/photos/originals/by-date/[0m
     Run the [0m[38;2;177;185;249mexiftool[0m pass first, otherwise rsync copies the files with [0m[38;2;177;185;249mno date taken [0m
     [0m[38;2;177;185;249mrecorded yet[0m into the root folder. The pass should move 240 files; then count the

     → I check the 12 album folders, open a sample from each (the 9 film rolls, plus
     [0m[38;2;177;185;249mcontact-sheet-index[0m compared to the printed sheet) and recount.

[0m[38;2;255;255;255m⏺ [0mNested lists:
    
  1. The first item at the top level has enough words in it to wrap onto a second row
     here. 
     a. A nested item under the first one also has enough words to wrap onto a second row.
        i. A third level item under the nested one has enough words to wrap onto a second
           row.
        ii. Another third level item.
     b. A second nested item.
  2. The second top level item.
     - A nested bullet under the second item that has enough words to wrap onto another
       row.
       - A deeper bullet under the nested bullet that has enough words to wrap onto
         another row.
